title: tinus nutans
intro: Tinus nutans, commonly known as Lantana camara, is a flowering plant native to the Americas and introduced to other parts of the world, including Asia and Africa. This invasive plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties and has shown potential in providing health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents present in Lantana camara include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-viral properties. The therapeutic actions of Lantana camara include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases, including cancer, diabetes, and infectious diseases.
